The name defaults to "Loop N" and the color to the default loop

``repeat_count`` is the total number of passes; ``None`` = infinite.

get.description:
Bounded raw PCM window (spec §11.4).

The asset is resolved once; the body, the content hash, and every
metadata header derive from that single resolution.
One binary peak tile (f32le per-channel min/max buckets).
Waveform levels and progressive tile availability (M1.8 manifest).

Authenticated download of one verified export (§19.2).

The response carries ``Content-Disposition: attachment`` with the
artifact's safe download filename, its exact byte length, and the
content hash for verification.
Registered bundled models with presence/verification state (§19.1).

post.description:
Verify one bundled model by size and SHA-256 (spec §19.1).

Local hashing only: no network, no inference. The result is recorded
for ``GET /models``.

get.description:
Authenticated download of one published portable archive (§19.2).

The response carries ``Content-Disposition: attachment`` with the
artifact's safe download filename, its exact byte length, and the
content hash for verification.
The session's acknowledged bytes, state, and last error.

post.description: Remove the session's upload files and metadata (idempotent).

put.description: Upload the next archive chunk with the import chunk protocol.

post.description:
Run the §18 open pipeline for a fully acknowledged transfer.

The blocking work (archive validation, extraction, database read,
remap, asset restoration, one transaction) runs in the threadpool —
no media job is dispatched. A failure keeps the session files so the
client can retry; success removes them.

get.description: Delivered export artifacts for a project, newest first.

post.description: Start a WAV export job for the selected stems (spec §15.3.1–3).

Resolve an existing playback representation or queue its creation.

``ready`` answers with the asset to play; ``preparing`` answers with
the (shared) job that will create the representation. A live job for
the same target rate is reused, never duplicated (spec §6.5.6).

get.description: The project's portable saves, newest first (spec §17.5).

post.description:
Save the working project as a portable archive (spec §17.1).

Synchronous by design: the save is file I/O only (archive, hash,
atomic publish) and never blocks on media work, so it runs in the
threadpool and returns the recorded artifact in one response.

post.description:
Request a separation run (spec §3.2, §9.2).

A live identical run is coalesced; a valid cached result is returned
without a job; otherwise the run + job are created. Preparation and
inference happen in the analysis worker.
